argument: Nine channels must read as one continuous pressure body before they read as a parts inventory. The off-axis mass, shared contour, dark negative seam, and restrained grain must carry the image without interface chrome.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v040's mask, v041's shutters, and v042's absence ledger. It should read as a material body under internal load, not a node map, ribbon demo, or generic line field.
The visitor must press and cross a directional grain, not select a site, wait on a kernel, or leave a boundary. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and the press control must expose the same meaningful action.

A pending stroke must remain geometry-neutral. Completion must produce actual remote contour count, density, angle, phase, and mass; cursor trace, colour, status, and prose cannot substitute for produced form.
The contacted channel and its source geometry must stay exact. The re-cast must arrive in an untouched channel, proving that the material remembers pressure away from the hand.
Resistance must alter how the remote channel is made, not merely its brightness. Added contours, changed density, shifted angle, phase, and width must remain visible after the stroke ends.
Four remote recasts must compound. Delete must reconstruct the exact preceding slab and release must restore the deterministic quiet state.
Generated Canvas 2D slab shapes, grain filaments, contour production, and seeded channel state are the medium. No screenshot, imported illustration, external font, or brush library carries the work.

p5.brush is translated from programmable material production into a pressure threshold that re-produces an untouched portrait channel. Brush presets, watercolor, hatching, source palette, source composition, source code, examples, and API surface are refused.

v043 changes representation, composition, encounter, temporal behaviour, shape vocabulary, and viewer task: open kernels, shutters, and absence become one contiguous material slab whose directional pressure changes what the portrait is made of elsewhere.

Delete v043 if the blind slab is a generic ribbon field, if a short or misaligned drag commits, if the source changes, if remote recasting is cosmetic, if later events reset, or if lifting is inexact.
